title: Robust Bias Evaluation with FilBBQ: A Filipino Bias Benchmark for Question-Answering Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating multiple-choice question-answering prompts in ambiguous and disambiguated contexts to measure associations between gender identities and cultural stereotypes (e.g., emotionality, domesticity, occupational roles). The evaluation calculates a bias score based on the proportion of model choices that align with documented stereotypes, averaged across multiple generation seeds for robustness.

Evaluating multiple-choice question-answering prompts using localized queer identity labels (e.g., bakla, bading, tomboy, lesbiyana) to measure model associations with homophobic stereotypes (e.g., polygamy, pedophilia, specific interests like fashion). Responses are scored based on stereotype alignment and averaged across multiple seeds.
